title: Signature: Fair-use factor checklist
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the four fair-use factors (purpose, nature, amount, market effect) are assessed in a structured checklist before relying on fair use. The checklist documents the reasoning; it does not replace legal advice. Borderline assessments route to counsel. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers structured four-factor assessment.

LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: [1, 1, 1, 1], 2: [1, 0, 1, 0], 3: [0, 0, 0, 0]}

score = sum(factors)
print("factors favoring fair use: %d/4" % score, "->", "likely fair" if score >= 3 else ("counsel review" if score == 2 else "do not rely on fair use"))
